claims.text: In-context learning exhibits low accuracy in cross-lingual sentiment classification scenarios.
In-context learning presents high calibration errors in cross-lingual sentiment classification scenarios.
N2C2 employs a k-nearest neighbors augmented classifier leveraging cached few-shot instances for prediction confidence calibration.
N2C2 incorporates confidence-aware distribution, semantically consistent retrieval representation, and adaptive neighbor combination modules.

evidence.description: Our findings suggest that ICL performs poorly in cross-lingual scenarios, exhibiting low accuracy.
Our findings suggest that ICL in cross-lingual scenarios presents high calibration errors.

We propose a novel approach, N2C2, which employs a k-nearest neighbors augmented classifier for prediction confidence calibration, narrowing the prediction gap by leveraging a datastore of cached few-shot instances.
N2C2 integrates the predictions from the datastore and incorporates confidence-aware distribution, semantically consistent retrieval representation, and adaptive neighbor combination modules.

methodologies.name: N2C2
methodologies.description: A k-nearest neighbors augmented classifier that integrates predictions from a cached few-shot instance datastore with confidence-aware distribution, semantically consistent retrieval representation, and adaptive neighbor combination modules for confidence calibration.

limitations.text: Standard in-context learning performs poorly in cross-lingual scenarios, exhibiting low accuracy and high calibration errors.
